# @stackline/update-section full reference

`@stackline/update-section@{{PACKAGE_VERSION}}` is an independent,
compatibility-first continuation of `update-section@0.3.3` under the MIT
license. Consult `REGISTRY_HANDOFF.md` for current publication status.

## API

- `updateSection(content, section, matchesStart, matchesEnd, top?)` replaces
  the first start marker through the first later end marker, both inclusive.
- A start without a later end replaces through EOF. With no start, the section
  is appended using two LF separators; truthy `top` prepends it instead.
- Falsey content returns the section without calling either matcher.
- Input is split and rejoined on LF. CRLF therefore passes trailing CR to
  matchers and preserves it on untouched lines.
- `updateSection.parse(lines, matchesStart, matchesEnd)` returns `hasStart`,
  `hasEnd`, `startIdx`, and inclusive `endIdx`.
- CommonJS exposes enumerable `.parse`; ESM exposes default, `updateSection`,
  and `parse`. The historical `update-section.js` entry remains available.

## Intentional corrections

The maintained parser makes `endIdx` consistently inclusive, reports `hasEnd`
only for a real end match, and ignores end markers before the selected start.
Callback observability is preserved. Replacement avoids upstream's
argument-count failure for large generated sections. Other normal output and
error behavior remain compatible.

## Verification target

The release gate includes licensed upstream cases, deterministic differential
tests, issues #1 and #2, crossed and missing markers, callback order and arity,
falsey and malformed values, LF/CRLF, large content, browser bundling, CommonJS,
ESM, TypeScript 3.9/current, Node 12-24, Linux/macOS/Windows, package analysis,
clean packed consumers, coverage, dependency audits, signatures, and docs.
Runtime, optional, and peer dependency counts are all zero.

Install: `npm install @stackline/update-section`
Alias: `npm install update-section@npm:@stackline/update-section`
Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-update-section
Security: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-update-section/security/policy
